name: services/cards/user
description: Get information on a user's ID cards.
brief_description: Get information on a user's ID cards.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
Array of dictionaries describing cards of access token issuer. Note that will be returned only:
  • student and phd cards that are not cancelled
  • staff cards that are not cancelled and not expired
each dictionary contains fields from card method
